decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD is a low-investment catalog item close to the established offer, and in a mail-order shop with a 60,000-item warehouse there is little cost to keeping it listed, though the small sunk cost and lack of public commitment make dropping it easier if it sells poorly.

The illustrated release series is a visible, curated label project with substantial design and production investment that embodies the firm's announced identity of carefully produced editions, so escalation of commitment favors continuing it and attributing any weak early sales to the series still building its audience.
